label: SAID_OF_1: SaidOf t s: t is predicated of s as belonging to what s is
definition: `SaidOf t s`: t is predicated of s as belonging to what s is (s falls within the ratio of t; s is not outside t). Used in both premises of the being-not-a-genus argument: the genus is not said of its differentia in this way, and being is said of every differentia in this way.
